value_proposition.text: Kettlemark tells independent kitchens how much to prep each day from their own sales, so they throw out less food and spend less time on the prep list.

citations.quote: Kettlemark suggests how much of each prep item to make, from the sales of the last four same weekdays.
Food thrown out fell from a median 11.2% of purchases in the baseline weeks to 7.9% in weeks 5-8.
The median time to write the daily prep list fell from 35 minutes to 12 minutes.

proof_points.text: In the pilot, the median share of purchases thrown out fell from 11.2% to 7.9%.

citations.quote: Food thrown out fell from a median 11.2% of purchases in the baseline weeks to 7.9% in weeks 5-8.

proof_points.text: Pilot kitchens logged a median 41 waste entries a week, against 6 in their paper logs.

citations.quote: Kitchens logged a median 41 waste entries a week, against 6 in the paper logs before.

proof_points.text: Prep amounts come from the sales of the last four same weekdays, not from a guess.

citations.quote: Kettlemark suggests how much of each prep item to make, from the sales of the last four same weekdays.

proof_points.text: Each waste entry records the item, the amount and a reason.

citations.quote: Each entry records the item, the amount and a reason.
